causal_observation_rules: G11 stale ciphertext must come from an actual SAF export in this run. Advance counters only through ordinary CredentialManager operations and independent RP verification; never edit a phone or RP counter to manufacture rejection.
Each negative case needs fresh provider eligibility and a current real CredentialManager request or documented platform refusal; unchanged RP state alone is insufficient.
Record eligibility/ticket freshness and operation timing; do not count natural five-minute index or three-minute ticket expiry as wrong-target/cancel proof.
Use actual RP option-request progression to demonstrate a fresh request where the fixture obtains options, and compare accepted events/key/counter separately from option allocation.
G01 and G10 require wrong_key_or_corrupt from the attempted wrong-password operation, not a missing-selection refusal.
G08 requires choose_backup_destination_first after cancelling a new picker and an unchanged original destination digest.
G09 requires choose_encrypted_vault_first after cancelling/failing a new picker, with no reactivation of the old staged input.
G11 requires a new independent RP verification_rejected event with counter_rollback_or_replay, not merely a generic fixture error.
A fresh native store on this same physical phone is an app-data reset/restore observation; do not claim a second physical passkey device or a measured private-directory inode.
A separately reviewed reset helper may be bound before its first case while earlier non-destructive cases run; pending helper work cannot pass or erase a case.
report_rules: Keep every case; report expected, executed, passed, failed, blocked and missing separately.
A successful ADB phase, installation, host test or signature-only unit test does not pass a CredentialManager behavior.
Retain initial failures and later candidate attempts; do not pool runtime hashes into one qualification.
Fresh-store restore on this one phone is not physical cross-device migration or generic passkey portability.
Latest-backup recovery is supported only when its counter has not been superseded at the strict RP.
Do not pool r4, the failed first r5 build, r5b or r6 artifacts into one result.
Preserve setup failures separately from all eighteen case states; phase success does not pass a case.
M07 passes only after settings, exact package absence, owned reverse mapping and tracked synthetic documents are all checked.

reset_admission.destructive_scope: only org.heptabao.passkey.preview, initially absent and currently matching this profile APK
reset_admission.helper_binding: freeze and independently review a separate helper SHA and case-specific checkpoint before any reset; the author cannot self-grant that review
